beats.text: Most men worry about their size. Most don't need to!
A review pooled seventeen studies and up to fifteen thousand men. Measured by health professionals. Not self-reported!
The average erect length: thirteen point one centimeters. About five point two inches.
Yet in a survey of over fifty thousand people, only fifty-five percent of men were happy with their size. And their partners?
Eighty-five percent of women were satisfied with their partner's size!
But knowing the average doesn't make the worry go away.
In one clinic, ninety-two men came in worried about their size. Getting measured and learning the real numbers relieved most of them.
So if it still bothers you, talk to a doctor. That's what helped.

ask: SEND THIS TO A FRIEND WHO WORRIES.
sources: Veale, Miles, Bramley, Muir & Hodsoll (2015), Am I normal? A systematic review and construction of nomograms for flaccid and erect penis length and circumference in up to 15,521 men, BJU International 115(6) – 17 studies, measured by health professionals; mean erect length 13.12 cm, erect circumference 11.66 cm.

Lever, Frederick & Peplau (2006), Does size matter? Men's and women's views on penis size across the lifespan, Psychology of Men & Masculinity 7(3) – 52,031 heterosexual men and women: 55% of men satisfied with their size, 85% of women satisfied with their partner's size.

Shamloul (2005), Treatment of men complaining of short penis, Urology 65(6), 1183–1185 – 92 men complaining of a short penis; sex education plus standard penile measurements (flaccid and stretched); most men found the combination helpful and relieving.
